AddedNode.description:
A node in the new revision that the old one lacks. `parent` is the id it
attaches under; absent means top level. gpui-agent flattens `node`, but
serde cannot refuse a flattened struct's unknown fields.

AgentEvent.description:
One host event. `seq` is the only ordering: events carry no clock.
`source` is the emitting component (gpui-agent's `target`).

Allowed.description: A press that may go ahead.

Approval.description: The person's yes to exactly one press.

at.description: When they said yes, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

AssertSpec.description: What `assert` and `wait_until` check about one node.

Bounds.description:
Bounds in whole logical pixels. gpui-agent uses f32; this crate has no
floats, so a host rounds. Hosts that cannot measure send zeros.

oneOf.description: A person, at the app.
The AI. `approval` is the person's yes, when there is one.
A scheduled routine. Nobody is there to approve anything.

Challenge.description:
The first line a host with a token writes on a new connection. The client
answers by putting HMAC-SHA256(token, nonce) in `auth` on each request.

target.description: The app whose host issued the challenge.

ChangedNode.description:
A node in both revisions with at least one differing field. `fields`
holds only the new values.

DeliveryMode.description:
How click, type and key reach the app. `semantic` (the default) calls the
widget's handler by id; `virtual` synthesizes in-window events.

Effect.description: What a tool or action does to the world.

oneOf.description: Looks, changes nothing.
Makes something a person can still review and throw away.
Changes the record: post, void, close, reopen.
Sends something outside, such as a return to the BIR.

Envelope.description:
One request: which app it is for, who is asking, and the op, whose fields
sit beside these on the wire.

oneOf.description:
Read the tree. `since` asks for a diff against a revision the client
holds, and `fingerprints` adds an id to fingerprint map.
Poll the bounded event stream for events after `since`.

`expect_fingerprint`, here and on the other input ops, is the
staleness gate: on a mismatch nothing happens.
Fire an action by its binding id.
What `assert` and `wait_until` check about one node.
Wait for the host to be ready.

Poll `until` until it holds or `timeout_ms` passes. gpui-agent flattens
the spec; serde cannot refuse unknown fields through a flatten here.

A PNG of the app's surface, written by the host to `path`. `node`
names the scroll view when `mode` is `scrolled`.

auth.description: HMAC-SHA256(token, session nonce) as lowercase hex. Never the raw token.

bot.description:
The Bot whose turn this is, set by the host. It only narrows: a host
refuses a screen another Bot's chat opened. Absent in a plain chat.

caller.description:
Set by the host from how the message arrived. Absent means nobody
established a caller, and every press is refused.

EventPoll.description: `result` of `events`. `lagged` means events were lost to the ring's limit.

Fill.description:
One input filled in from shared context rather than by the caller. It
names where the value comes from (such as `period`), never the value.

from.description: The context key that supplies it.

Grant.description: Which apps may read a ref.

HelloAuth.description: Whether the host needs `auth` on every request.

HelloInfo.description: The `hello` answer. `targets` lists the apps this host routes to.

Op.description:
What a message asks the target to do. Ops without fields are written as
empty struct variants because serde would ignore extra fields on unit ones.

oneOf.description:
Read the tree. `since` asks for a diff against a revision the client
holds, and `fingerprints` adds an id to fingerprint map.
Poll the bounded event stream for events after `since`.

`expect_fingerprint`, here and on the other input ops, is the
staleness gate: on a mismatch nothing happens.
Fire an action by its binding id.
What `assert` and `wait_until` check about one node.
Wait for the host to be ready.

Poll `until` until it holds or `timeout_ms` passes. gpui-agent flattens
the spec; serde cannot refuse unknown fields through a flatten here.

A PNG of the app's surface, written by the host to `path`. `node`
names the scroll view when `mode` is `scrolled`.

PressAction.description: The press being decided, as the host knows it.

args_hash.description: The arguments about to go out. Absent means no open press.

once.description:
The open press's one-time id. Absent when the host has no open press
for this action.

shown_hash.description: What the card shows now. Absent means no open press.

PressedBy.description: Whose press this was, to show and to log.

oneOf.description: The person pressed it.

The AI pressed it after the person approved this press. The host
retires `once` now.
The AI pressed something that needs no person.
A routine pressed something that needs no person.

Provenance.description:
Where a piece of context came from. Holds no content, only handles and a
hash of it.

from.description: What it was made from. Empty for an original, such as an upload.

Refused.description: Why a press may not go ahead.

oneOf.description: The action is missing, malformed, or has an effect nobody knows.
The caller is missing, malformed, or of a kind nobody knows.
A routine reached for an action that needs a person.
The AI has no approval for an action that needs a person.
The approval names no person, so the AI can't approve its own press.
The approval is for another app.
The approval is for another action.
The host has no open press for this action, so no approval can match.
The approval is for another press of this action, such as a used one.
The approval is for other arguments.
The approval is for another card than the one showing now.
The AI reached for a filing: no approval covers one.

Response.description: One answer. `id` matches the request and `target` is the app that answered.

ScreenshotMode.description: How `screenshot` captures: the painted window, or scrolled and stitched.

SnapshotFormat.description: The `snapshot` answer's form: the JSON tree, or one line per visible node.

SnapshotResult.description:
`result` of a `snapshot` with `since` or `format: "compact"`. One of:
nothing changed; a diff; the full tree is in `tree` because the revision
is too old; or the compact text.

ToolSpec.description:
One operation. All of `effect`, `needs`, `fills_in` and `returns` are
required on the wire: an empty list is a statement, a missing one is not.

TreeDiff.description: What a client at one revision needs to reach another.

UiNode.description:
One node. `visible` is left out when true, and `states` and `children`
when empty.

UiTree.description: One app's tree at one revision.

rev.description: Absent when the host tracks no revision: rebuild, do not cache.

ValueKind.description:
The shape of an input or a result. Amounts are integers (centavos), so
there is no decimal kind.

oneOf.description: A `ctx://` ref.
